title: Russian general Alexeyev in German magazine
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Russian general Alexeyev in German magazine, about 2000 at Russia / Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Russian general Vasilei Alexa coming out in a German magazine 2000 saying >> this stuff.
Russian General Vasilei Alexv said that UFOs would show up when they transported sensitive scientific technology.
tellings.difference: Says what the claim was (UFOs appeared while sensitive scientific technology was being transported) but does not mention the 2000 German magazine.
tellings.link_reason: Both are General Vasily Alexeyev's public statement about UFOs. This telling gives what he said: UFOs appeared when sensitive technology was being moved.

as_told.title: Soviet UFOs during transport of sensitive technology

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2000 a Russian general named Vasily Alexeyev spoke publicly in a German magazine about UFOs. Michels raises it in a talk about UFOs reportedly appearing around nuclear missiles, and suggests that the general was describing the same kind of thing. That would mean similar events had been noticed on the Russian side too.
